title: Lead Software Engineer

additionalInformation.label: RFIMS Operations, Maintenance and Sustainment award (up to $49.0 million)

description: Led an 11-person team building the reusable, extensible RFIMS baseline under a development contract valued at up to $148.4 million. Designed the cloud architecture for radio-frequency data analysis across embedded collection systems and AWS, establishing a foundation that could be extended for future operational deployments.
highlights: Designed major system components in MagicDraw and coordinated an 11-person team around a modular baseline intended for reuse in future operational deployments.
Built the AWS architecture around EC2, Route 53, and RDS to host data-classification and workflow services.
Replaced a Groovy workflow engine that could not meet throughput needs with a JavaScript and Node.js backend designed to scale more easily.
Developed the JavaScript and React frontend used to operate and monitor processing workflows.
Automated cloud infrastructure with Python and Ansible and established continuous integration for the project.
